facts.fact: The vendor Linking Development says its Terlink municipal software includes accounting and taxation modules covering recovery and management of communal taxes; what is recorded (payers or payments only) is not stated.
Linking Development states that more than 20 communes in Senegal are equipped with Terlink; no total of communes is given and use is not stated. Dated to the publication month.
Terlink is presented as a vendor product of Linking Development supplied to communes; no ministry owner, plan or funding is stated.

systems.platform: all-in-one municipal management software plus communal website
systems.tiers: Communes; modules for civil status, planning and land, accounting and taxation
